name: shop-serve~p1
task: Each time a client arrives, take their order, get food from the pantry, prepare it at the stove and hand it over; should the food fall, your very next move must pick it up.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the clauses omit the food-fetching step. The task says 'get food from the pantry' as part of each client's routine, but no clause links the fall-recovery duty or the order-serving to actually picking up food; in particular ChainResponse(food_fell, holding_food) (R5) is right, but the fetch itself is unrepresented: nothing makes holding_food occur, and 'get food from the pantry' must appear as its own clause, e.g. a hard Response(client_arrived, holding_food) (holding_food is a lasting condition fetched during the routine, so link events around it: Response(client_arrived, order_taken), Response(order_taken, food_prepared), Response(food_prepared, order_served) are already there — add the fetch so the routine includes it).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a rule-only 'each time' task: every clause traces to its phrase. Response(client_arrived, order_taken) covers 'each time a client arrives, take their order'; Response(order_taken, holding_food) and Response(food_prepared, order_served) cover 'get food... prepare it... hand it over' as a 'whenever' chain, where pantry fetch is only a lasting condition and correctly skipped; ChainResponse(food_fell, holding_food) matches 'should the food fall, your very next move must pick it up'. All hard, no preference cues, no added requirements.
